_readme: AI assistant. `faqs` power demo mode (server-side intent matching: `intents` are keywords scored against the visitor's message). `systemPromptTemplate` + `knowledgeBase` power live mode when an LLM_API_KEY is configured. Keep both in sync with your real story.
label: ai assistant
heading: Ask me anything.
description: A small demo of how I build AI features: this assistant answers questions about my work using a structured knowledge base, with intent matching, streamed responses and graceful fallbacks.

disclaimer.demo: ▸ demo mode: answers come from a local knowledge base via intent matching · no LLM, no API key needed · swap-ready for a live model
disclaimer.live: ▸ live mode: answers are generated by an LLM grounded in a curated knowledge base · it can make mistakes, so verify anything important

greeting: Hi, I'm John's AI assistant. Ask about his full-stack work, infrastructure and DevSecOps, security engineering, or availability, or tap a suggested question.

knowledgeBase.summary: John Filhmar Ola is a full-stack software engineer based in Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines (UTC+8). He owns systems end to end, from architecture and TypeScript across React and Node.js to CI/CD and the servers they run on. He is Lead IT Systems Developer at YouCode Technologies Corporation (July 2025 to present), promoted from Developer to Lead IT within his first year, and owns six commercial systems there. He uses Claude Code daily, with every generated change reviewed and tested. Open to work; he replies to email within 24 hours.

sections.title: Strengths
sections.content: Owning systems end to end, from first commit to production operation. John was the sole developer of Usapp, a secure real-time messaging platform spanning mobile client, distributed backend microservices, deployment pipeline and production server management. He is equally at home in full-stack development, DevSecOps pipelines, and on-premise infrastructure.

sections.title: Projects
sections.content: Tara LEVEL UP! (tara.filhmar.online): a gamified quest app where a local LLM verifies each finished task from a photo, voice or short quiz entirely on the phone, awards XP under fixed rules, and recomputes the leaderboard server-side to stop cheating; built from scratch in 21 hours at the AppBuildersPH Hackathon 2026 with team BOOM TARA TARA G. Usapp (usapp.ph): end-to-end encrypted messaging with client-side keys, passwordless OTP sign-in with revocable device sessions, WebSocket delivery coordinated through Redis, and a partner API; live on iOS and Android and the push-notification backbone for every other company product (React Native, NestJS, gRPC, RabbitMQ, Socket.IO, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). Real-Time Trade Blotter (fusion.filhmar.online): built in about a week with Claude Code for a trading platform assessment, with exact decimal prices, a database-enforced audit trail, optimistic concurrency and keyset pagination; deployed to AWS behind nginx with TLS, with 325 unit, 39 integration and 10 end-to-end tests and a load-test p95 of 209 ms. JMS E-Talyer (jms-e-talyer.shop): an offline-capable PWA for multi-branch automotive shops with barcode scanning and server-authoritative conflict resolution that replays offline orders safely on reconnect; live in production with 400+ backend tests and security scanning gating every release, on a server John operates (Next.js, Express, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions). YouFlow (kanban.youcodetech.com): an MCP server where each AI agent acts with one user's exact permissions, AI estimates held behind a supervisor approval gate, and an append-only audit log (Express, Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis). YouGuard Master Bridge Server: one Go service with per-hardware-family adapters that writes every event to disk before sending and replays unacknowledged events oldest first on reconnect, and streams RTSP camera feeds to a live WebRTC video wall; deployed on customer sites. Also at YouCode: a per-client HR platform, a white-label civic super-app live for three cities (MyDasma, MySorsogon, MyLegazpi), and an offline-first learning platform. Other work: Kalusugapp, his BSIT capstone, a patient records and appointment system deployed at the Victoria Municipal Health Office; PeraPlano, a privacy-first Android budgeting app (in development); GeneSys, a game-based biology learning platform; and the Flood Notification System, an IoT early-warning system.

sections.title: Stack
sections.content: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, C#, SQL, Bash. Front end: React, Next.js, React Native (Expo), Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, PWAs. Back end: Node.js, Express, NestJS, Python (Django), REST APIs, gRPC, WebSockets, Socket.IO. Messaging: RabbitMQ (AMQP), Redis Pub/Sub, background jobs. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis, Prisma, pgvector. DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Linux, nginx, AWS EC2, Prometheus, Grafana. Security: SAST, SCA, DAST, Trivy, gitleaks, cosign, SOPS. AI features: LLM APIs, MCP servers, prompt engineering, human review gates. Testing: Jest, Vitest, Playwright, JUnit, k6 load testing.

sections.title: Career
sections.content: Feb to May 2025: Frontend and Web Developer Intern at Ynnovision Enterprise Solutions, a 486-hour internship building responsive front-end features. July 2025 to present: Lead IT Systems Developer at YouCode Technologies Corporation; joined as Developer and was promoted to Lead IT within the first year; owns six commercial systems end to end, builds TypeScript microservices over gRPC and RabbitMQ, owns CI/CD with SAST, SCA, container and secret scanning and signed deploys, and runs Prometheus and Grafana monitoring. Education: BS Information Technology, Mindoro State University (2021 to 2025). Programming (Java) NC III, TESDA via BCRV Tech-Voc (2025): top 1 awardee of the cohort, Best in Participation and Best in LMS Submission, graduation inspirational speaker. AppBuildersPH Hackathon 2026 (October 2026, SM Makati): built Tara LEVEL UP!, a local-AI mobile app, in 21 hours. Languages: English (professional working), Filipino and Tagalog (native).

sections.title: Contact & availability
sections.content: Email olajohnfilhmar@gmail.com. Replies within 24 hours. Based in Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines (UTC+8). Open to work in full-stack, DevSecOps and infrastructure roles and collaborations. LinkedIn and GitHub links are in the contact section.

faqs.question: What's your strongest area?
faqs.answer: John's strongest area is owning systems end to end: from architecture and full-stack code to CI/CD, security and the on-premise servers it runs on. He built Usapp, a secure real-time messaging platform, single-handedly across mobile, distributed microservices, deployment pipeline and production infrastructure.

faqs.question: Tell me about your full-stack work
faqs.answer: John builds across the whole stack: React and React Native on the front, NestJS/Node microservices behind them, and PostgreSQL/MongoDB/MySQL/Redis for data. JMS E-Talyer is a good example: a multi-branch automotive service system he built, secured, deployed and now operates himself.

faqs.question: What have you built at YouCode?
faqs.answer: As Lead IT Systems Developer at YouCode Technologies, John owns six commercial systems end to end. They include Usapp, end-to-end encrypted messaging live on iOS and Android and the push-notification backbone for every other product; YouFlow, an AI-native Kanban whose MCP server lets AI agents act with one user's exact permissions; the YouGuard Master Bridge Server, a Go edge service that buffers site events through network outages; a per-client HR platform; a white-label civic super-app live for three cities; and an offline-first learning platform.

faqs.question: What about backend and distributed systems?
faqs.answer: Deep experience. Usapp is a distributed microservice backend with real-time messaging and push delivery, built from scratch and now the notification backbone for his company's entire product suite. He works across REST, gRPC, WebSockets and message queues (RabbitMQ), and designs services to be owned end to end.

faqs.question: How do you approach DevSecOps and CI/CD?
faqs.answer: John owned CI/CD across a whole product suite: automated build, test, security scanning, artifact signing and deployment, including self-hosted runner infrastructure. JMS E-Talyer runs a four-workflow pipeline (integration, security scanning, gated deployment, dependency management) with hardened, non-root containers and secrets injected at runtime.

faqs.question: Do you manage infrastructure?
faqs.answer: Yes, he led on-premise infrastructure operations: server provisioning, container orchestration, monitoring stack deployment, and production incident diagnosis. For JMS E-Talyer he provisions, secures, manages and operates the VPS himself, end to end.

faqs.question: What about security?
faqs.answer: Security is baked into his pipelines, not bolted on: static analysis, dependency auditing, secret scanning across full git history, dynamic testing and container vulnerability scanning, plus signed artifacts and SBOM/SLSA provenance. Application-side he does security headers, origin allow-listing, tiered rate limiting, scoped CSRF and error sanitisation.

faqs.question: Do you do hardware/IoT?
faqs.answer: He does. The Flood Notification System is a sensor-based early-warning platform with sirens, warning lights and GSM SMS dispatch that tracks both water level and rate of rise per area. He's also built hardware-to-server integration for a campus attendance and security system.

faqs.question: What mobile work have you done?
faqs.answer: John builds mobile in React Native (Expo). Usapp, his end-to-end encrypted messaging app, is live on iOS and Android. At the AppBuildersPH Hackathon 2026 his team built Tara LEVEL UP! in 21 hours: a quest app where an on-device LLM checks each finished task from a photo, voice or quiz, fully offline. PeraPlano, a privacy-first Android budgeting app, is in development.

faqs.question: Have you led teams?
faqs.answer: Yes, he was promoted from Developer to Lead IT at YouCode Technologies within his first year, and owned multiple production systems across the company. His practice covers full-stack ownership, microservice design, code review, technical documentation and agile delivery.

DevOps and security: Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, nginx, AWS EC2, Prometheus, Grafana, Trivy, gitleaks, cosign, SOPS. Testing: Jest, Vitest, Playwright, JUnit, k6.

faqs.question: How does this assistant work?
faqs.answer: Honest answer: out of the box I'm a demo: a curated knowledge base with intent matching and streamed responses, served by a small API route. Add one API key to the server config and the same route upgrades me to a live LLM with the same knowledge base. John built me this way on purpose.

faqs.question: Say hi
faqs.answer: Hey! Ask me about John's full-stack work, backend and microservices, DevSecOps and infrastructure, security, mobile/IoT, or availability. Or tap one of the suggested questions.

faqs.question: How do you use AI in your work?
faqs.answer: John uses Claude Code daily for building, testing, debugging and documentation. Project context files and custom skills keep it on decisions already made, and every generated diff is reviewed, with tests as the gate before merge. The Real-Time Trade Blotter shows the result: built in about a week, deployed to AWS with 325 unit, 39 integration and 10 end-to-end tests and a load-test p95 of 209 ms.
